invariants.rationale: If processing occurs, at least one tileset is added; if not, tilesets might already be non-empty.
imageResolver is called via getImage, so it is expected to be non-null when used.
element and its name are accessed, so they must both be non-null when logic proceeds.

map and its tile sets are referenced, so both must be non-null in method logic.
